mapper.sql: CASE WHEN s.is_attachment_review_required THEN coalesce(a.decision_status_code,'REVIEW_REQUIRED') ELSE coalesce(b.decision_status_code,s.semantic_status_code,'REVIEW_REQUIRED') END

CASE WHEN NOT s.is_attachment_review_required THEN coalesce(b.reason_code,s.semantic_reason_code,'BASE_CLASSIFICATION_REQUIRED') WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN a.reason_code WHEN s.attachment_intake_status_code IN ('PROFILE_REQUIRED','BASE_RECLASSIFICATION_REQUIRED','POLICY_BINDING_CHANGED') THEN s.attachment_intake_status_code WHEN j.base_evaluation_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id AND j.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ATTACHMENT_STALE' WHEN j.job_status_code IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED','CONFLICT') THEN 'ATTACHMENT_PROCESSING_FAILED' ELSE 'ATTACHMENT_PENDING' END

coalesce( (SELECT string_agg(c.category_code,',' ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_confirmed_target_categories t JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE t.source_id=s.id AND t.based_on_evaluation_id=b.id AND t.confirmation_status_code='CURRENT'), (SELECT string_agg(c.category_code,',' ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_classification_target_matches t JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=b.id))

coalesce( (SELECT string_agg(c.support_type_code,',' ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_confirmed_support_types t JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE t.source_id=s.id AND t.based_on_evaluation_id=b.id AND t.confirmation_status_code='CURRENT'), (SELECT string_agg(c.support_type_code,',' ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_classification_support_matches t JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=b.id))

(SELECT string_agg(c.category_code,',' ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=a.id AND ((cf.id IS NOT NULL AND t.confirmation_id=cf.id AND t.origin_code='CONFIRMED') OR (cf.id IS NULL AND t.origin_code='AUTO')))

(SELECT string_agg(c.support_type_code,',' ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=a.id AND ((cf.id IS NOT NULL AND t.confirmation_id=cf.id AND t.origin_code='CONFIRMED') OR (cf.id IS NULL AND t.origin_code='AUTO')))

FROM announcement_source_snapshots s LEFT JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations b ON b.source_id=s.id AND b.is_current LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations a ON a.id=s.current_attachment_evaluation_id AND a.source_id=s.id AND a.is_current AND a.base_evaluation_id=b.id AND a.content_version_id=b.content_version_id AND a.rule_release_id=b.rule_release_id AND (NOT s.is_attachment_review_required OR a.policy_id=s.attachment_policy_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_attachment_sets sealed WHERE sealed.id=a.set_id AND sealed.source_id=s.id AND sealed.set_status_code='SEALED') LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_sets aset ON aset.id=a.set_id AND aset.source_id=s.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.id,c.source_id,c.evaluation_id,c.set_hash, coalesce(r.source_version,c.confirmed_source_version) AS effective_source_version, coalesce(r.attachment_version,c.confirmed_attachment_version) AS effective_attachment_version FROM announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c LEFT JOIN LATERAL attachment_confirmation_restored_binding(c.source_id,c.id) r ON true WHERE c.source_id=s.id AND c.is_current ) cf ON cf.evaluation_id=a.id AND cf.set_hash=aset.manifest_hash AND cf.effective_source_version=s.classification_row_version AND (cf.effective_attachment_version=s.attachment_row_version OR (cf.effective_attachment_version=s.attachment_row_version-1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links confirmed_link WHERE confirmed_link.source_id=s.id AND confirmed_link.attachment_confirmation_id=cf.id))) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT q.id,q.base_evaluation_id,q.content_version_id,q.set_id,q.job_status_code,q.error_code FROM announcement_attachment_jobs q WHERE q.source_id=s.id AND q.batch_id IS NULL ORDER BY q.expected_attachment_version DESC,q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) j ON true LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_sets jset ON jset.id=j.set_id AND jset.source_id=s.id AND j.base_evaluation_id=b.id AND j.content_version_id=b.content_version_id
s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND (b.id IS NULL OR (b.decision_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND b.title_stage_code IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED')))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs active_job WHERE active_job.source_id=s.id AND active_job.batch_id IS NULL AND active_job.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED'))
(a.id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_attachment_evaluations old WHERE old.source_id=s.id))

-- AttachmentProcessingFlow와 같은 우선순위. NULL/미지 코드/실패를 준비 완료로 승격하지 않는다. CASE WHEN s.is_attachment_review_required IS NOT TRUE THEN 'NOT_APPLIED' WHEN b.id IS NULL THEN 'CLASSIFICATION_PENDING' WHEN s.attachment_intake_status_code IN ('PROFILE_REQUIRED','BASE_RECLASSIFICATION_REQUIRED','POLICY_BINDING_CHANGED') THEN 'CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED' WHEN ()='ATTACHMENT_STALE' THEN 'EVIDENCE_STALE' WHEN OR coalesce(j.job_status_code,'NOT_REQUESTED') IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED') THEN 'AUTOMATIC_PROCESSING' WHEN THEN 'EVIDENCE_STALE' WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN coalesce(j.job_status_code,'NOT_REQUESTED')='NOT_REQUESTED' THEN 'AUTOMATIC_PROCESSING' ELSE 'TECHNICAL_EXCEPTION' END WHEN a.set_id IS NULL OR (aset.manifest_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE OR (coalesce(j.job_status_code,'NOT_REQUESTED') IN ('NOT_REQUESTED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','PARTIAL_FAILED','CANCELLED','CONFLICT')) IS NOT TRUE OR (a.decision_status_code IN ('ACCEPTED','REVIEW_REQUIRED')) IS NOT TRUE THEN 'TECHNICAL_EXCEPTION' WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'FINAL_REVIEW_CONFIRMED' WHEN (aset.is_discovery_complete IS TRUE AND aset.discovered_count=aset.processed_count AND ((aset.discovery_status_code='NO_FILES' AND aset.discovered_count=0) OR (aset.discovery_status_code='FOUND' AND aset.discovered_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10)) AND a.reason_code IN ('TARGET_SUPPORT_CONFIRMED','EXTENDED_TARGET_SUPPORT_CONFIRMED', 'TITLE_GROUP_A_MATCHED','BODY_GROUP_A_MATCHED','BODY_GROUP_B_MATCHED','ATTACHMENT_GROUP_A_MATCHED', 'ATTACHMENT_GROUP_B_MATCHED','ATTACHMENT_CONTEXT_REVIEW','EXTENDED_COMBINATION_NOT_CONFIRMED', 'BODY_COMBINATION_NOT_CONFIRMED') AND coalesce(j.job_status_code,'NOT_REQUESTED') IN ('SUCCEEDED','NOT_REQUESTED')) IS NOT TRUE THEN 'TECHNICAL_EXCEPTION' WHEN a.decision_status_code='ACCEPTED' THEN 'READY_FOR_FINAL_REVIEW' ELSE 'FINAL_REVIEW_EXCEPTION' END

WHERE AND s.provider_code=#{providerCode} AND ()=#{effectiveStatusCode} AND coalesce(j.job_status_code,'NOT_REQUESTED')=#{jobStatusCode} AND ()=#{processingFlowStatusCode}
AND #{targetCategoryCode}=ANY(string_to_array( CASE WHEN s.is_attachment_review_required THEN ELSE END,','))
AND #{supportTypeCode}=ANY(string_to_array( CASE WHEN s.is_attachment_review_required THEN ELSE END,','))
AND (position(lower(#{keyword}) IN lower(s.title))>0 OR position(lower(#{keyword}) IN lower(s.agency_name))>0)
AND s.collected_at>=(CAST(#{collectedFrom} AS date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AND s.collected_at<((CAST(#{collectedTo} AS date)+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')

s.id AS source_id,s.public_code,s.provider_code,s.title,s.agency_name,s.application_end_date,s.collected_at,s.review_status_code, b.id AS base_decision_id,coalesce(b.decision_status_code,s.semantic_status_code,'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS base_status, coalesce(b.reason_code,s.semantic_reason_code,'BASE_CLASSIFICATION_REQUIRED') AS base_reason,b.rule_release_id, AS base_target_codes, AS base_support_codes, a.id AS attachment_decision_id,a.decision_status_code AS attachment_status,a.reason_code AS attachment_reason, a.set_id,aset.manifest_hash AS set_hash,a.input_hash, AS attachment_target_codes, AS attachment_support_codes, AS effective_status, AS effective_reason, s.is_attachment_review_required AS review_required, AS attachment_stale, s.attachment_policy_id AS policy_id,cf.id AS confirmation_id, CASE WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CURRENT' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_attachment_confirmations old WHERE old.source_id=s.id) THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'NONE' END AS confirmation_status, s.classification_row_version AS source_version,s.attachment_row_version AS attachment_version, j.id AS job_id,coalesce(j.job_status_code,'NOT_REQUESTED') AS job_status,j.error_code AS job_error, s.attachment_intake_status_code AS intake_status, coalesce(aset.discovery_status_code,jset.discovery_status_code) AS discovery_status, coalesce(aset.is_discovery_complete,jset.is_discovery_complete) AS discovery_complete, coalesce(aset.discovered_count,jset.discovered_count) AS discovered_count, coalesce(aset.processed_count,jset.processed_count) AS processed_count, AS active_normal_job
mapper.select: -- base/effective/preview를 분리하며 아래 count와 정확히 같은 권한 범위·상태·태그 필터를 사용한다. SELECT ORDER BY s.collected_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET ((#{page}-1)*#{size})
-- COLLECT_ONLY preview를 유효 후보 건수에 합산하지 않는다. SELECT count(1)
